meta.Syllabus Name: Integrate single page application with Spring Boot_Tích hợp ứng dụng trang đơn với Spring Boot
meta.Course Name English: Integrate single page application with Spring Boot
meta.Learning-Teaching Method: Project based learning,Problem based learning,Active learning,In-class lecture
meta.Time Allocation: Study hour (300h) = 90h contact hours + 145-minute final exam + 207.6h self-study
meta.Description:
Upon completion of this course students shoud:
1. Understand the followings:
• ReactJS concepts for building Front-End application
• RESTful API concepts
• RESTful API using Spring Boot's built-in features and frameworks
• Security features (authentication and authorization) with RESTful API
• Handling HTTP requests and responses using Spring Boot's framework
• Error handling and exception management in Spring Boot RESTful APIs
2. Be able to:
• Build RESTful APIs using Spring Boot's built-in features and frameworks
• Implement security features with authentication and authorization
• Handle HTTP requests and responses using Spring Boot's framework
• Build Front-End application using ReactJS components
• Integrate Spring Boot with other technologies and frameworks SQL Server, MongoDB, and ReactJS
3. Be able to work in team and present group's results
meta.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time
- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
meta.Tools:
- Internet
- IntelliJ IDEA
- JDK 21
- Platform: SpringBoot 3, Node 21
